$comment: Named counter groups. Patterns are case-insensitive globs over counter names. confidence: verified (names seen on hardware through this server), transcribed (from vendor plugin strings or docs, not run here), unverified (best guess). Vendor blocks never match D3D counters (groups 'D3D: ...'); only 'any' blocks do. Intel names were listed by pix_gpu_counters_list on an Intel Arc B580 (driver 32.0.101.8991, PIX 2606.18-preview, 2026-09-14): 259 INTEL counters whose units live in descriptions ('Percentage of time', 'Number of'). NVIDIA (RTX 4070 Ti) and AMD (Radeon iGPU 32.0.21018.14) expose only the 22 D3D counters on this machine, so their vendor blocks stay guesses.

stalls.description: Why shader threads wait: dependencies, sends, barriers, instruction fetch, dispatch queues and memory latency.
